title: Our 2025 Impact Report Is Here
summary: A look back at the families and programs we supported this year, and what's next.
body: This year we expanded three of our core programs and welcomed new research partners focused on early diagnosis tools. The full report includes program-by-program breakdowns, caregiver feedback, and our roadmap for the coming year. A downloadable version will be available soon on the About Us page.

title: Fall Family Toolkit Orientation
summary: A free orientation session to help families set up their first Elevate Minds tool.
body: Join us for a 90-minute virtual session where our team walks families through choosing and configuring the right free tool for their child, based on age, condition, and goals. No cost, no obligation — just bring your questions. Registration details will be posted closer to the date.

title: New Research Partnership on Early Diagnosis Models
summary: We're partnering with a university developmental-pediatrics lab to improve our early screening tools.
body: This partnership will help us validate and improve the Early Signals screening model with a larger, more diverse dataset, while keeping the tool free and available to every family who wants to use it as a conversation-starter with their pediatrician.

title: Sign Language Avatar Classroom Pilot Kickoff
summary: We're piloting our sign-language avatar tool in five new classrooms this fall.
body: Building on last year's classroom deployments, this pilot brings the Sign Language Avatar tool to five additional classrooms, with a focus on gathering feedback from deaf students and their teachers to guide the next round of improvements.

title: Thank You to Our Volunteers
summary: A note of appreciation for the volunteers who made this year's programs possible.
body: None of our free programs would be possible without the technologists, educators, and therapists who volunteer their time. Thank you for everything you've contributed this year — from workshop facilitation to code reviews to classroom visits.
